answer: Every task mints its own session key, holds that key in a shale escrow contract until the work reaches finality, then rotates it, so a duplicate bid signed with a retired key is rejected by the replay log instead of being matched by account name. A 500-identity farm now needs 500 funded escrows alive through finality before it earns a single fee, and that hollow arithmetic kills the arbitrage. The mirror is unkind: replay catches reuse, and reuse is all a farm has.
